instructions: If your harness can dispatch the agent type natively, use the native tool call rather than AGX. Bounded reads, summaries, and single-file checks are not delegation tasks - do them in context.

implementer.instructions: The daily driver. Implementation and bug fixing; every repository edit.

planner.instructions: Planning and specs, usually user-invoked. Plans and specs get reviewed through a different harness from the author.

monitor.instructions: Owns one PR end to end: monitors CI and review providers, judges ordinary findings, fixes them inline, pushes, and merges. Escalates only genuinely entangled findings.

reviewer.instructions: Never the author's harness. This is a preference order, not a caller mapping: the resolver drops any entry whose harness equals --author-harness case-insensitively and takes the first survivor. Sol leads because the implementer is opus-5, so most work is Claude-authored; Codex-authored work falls through to fable-5-1 high.

ux.instructions: Vision review of UX captures. Must be a vision-capable route.

gate.instructions: Batched gate review and the boundary's final review. The most capable route on each harness.
